violation_type.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record
violation_type.typical_finding: Seven out of eleven staff files did not contain certificates. The training certificates observed did not include the individual's name. The Director stated that the training certificates has not been completed.

finding_variants.text: Seven out of eleven staff files did not contain certificates. The training certificates observed did not include the individual's name. The Director stated that the training certificates has not been completed.
The training certificates in file  did not have caregivers information therefore they cannot be counted towards compliance for annual trainings.

Ten staff files observed did not include the original certificate related to the training topic/subject received. The documents within the staff files did not include the trainer's name, qualifications, and/or the length of training.
During time of investigation inspection, staff hired on 4/10/2023 did not have name on certificate.
Four of the four reviewed staff training records had incomplete certificates. They did have the date or signature.
At that time of inspection, one staff file lacked documentation of 22 hours of training for the training year Jan 2023-24.
